actual_scope: In the established singleton F2 dirty-connector alphabet, construct an exact complete-call-floor schedule for nine read-only source maps B0..B8 and five distinct dirty output maps Ai with supports S1=01234, S2=01235, S3=01256, S4=01567, S5=05678. These five weight-five masks form a path in J(9,5), each step replacing one source, and use all nine sources.
scope_change_reason: The selected card asks to extend the connector alphabet, but the live connector and output-path lanes are crowded. This scope adds no operation: it tests an explicit sparse support family whose consecutive masks form a Johnson path. It is distinct from Cycle 31 PR #2283, which searched a two-sweep path for all 70 weight-four masks at n=8 and found a scoped obstruction, and from PR #2271, a 12-row local bit-register tour through three different masks.
bottleneck_link: A path through sparse output supports can share repeated B-source transitions and remove work from a recursive connector interface; reaching the 2n+2p call floor is a precise local target, while supplier placement and weighted child prices remain open.
stop_rule: Screen the fully charged per-complete-call floor against separate row stars. If favorable, construct the explicit n=9, r=5, p=5 Johnson path; replay all 32768 dirty scalar cases and run one-readout, wrong-boundary and missing-restoration controls. Stop after the exact replay and lower-bound proof; do not search unrelated support families or infer supplier placement/kappa.
evidence: PASS_NINE_SOURCE_WEIGHT_FIVE_JOHNSON_CHAIN: 18 source calls plus ten readouts = exact 28-call floor; five independent row stars cost 60. Both schedules were replayed for all 32768 arbitrary dirty scalar states. Single-readout leakage, wrong-boundary and missing-restoration controls pass. Source incidence vector is (5,4,3,2,1,4,3,2,1); for stable positive per-call prices the exact saving over row stars is 2*sum_j(d_j-1)c_j, while A-call prices cancel. No supplier placement or kappa claim.
